'''Flash''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Siege" /> They were a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] created from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], and as such they stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Clone Databank" /> Flash was a member of the 501st's [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] and<ref name="Siege" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> spent some [[Time/Legends|time]] in the Grand Army of the Republic's [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] and sat with fellow [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] [[Checkers]], [[Coric]], and [[Dandy]]. Eventually, Flash, along with the rest of Torrent [[Company/Legends|Company]], geared up and boarded a [[Troop carrier/Legends|troop carrier]] which took them to the ''[[Indomitable (Republic cruiser)|Indomitable]]'', a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. Aboard the cruiser, Torrent Company left for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] to rescue [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] who were trapped behind enemy lines.<ref name="Siege" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flash appeared in the novel, ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]'', authored by [[Karen Miller]] and published in [[2010]].<ref name="Siege" /> Flash shares names with [[Flash/Legends|another clone]] from the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode ''[[Jedi Crash]]''.<ref name="jc">{{TCW|Jedi Crash}}</ref> While the two clones share the same name, they are not the same person as the clone from the episode [[Death/Legends|dies]] in the year [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="EpisodeDate">{{TCWdates|113}}</ref> while the clone from the novel is seen alive the year after, in 21 BBY.<ref name="TERC" />
